injury: right toe sore again (turf toe from Week 1) after Week 4 (Sep 28)

news.source: Matt Maiocco, NBC Sports Bay Area (Kyle Shanahan, conference call)
news.words: Shanahan said Monday that Purdy reported soreness in his right toe after Sunday's loss, and there is concern whether he will be available Thursday. "I'm concerned with anybody who's not totally healthy at this moment."

Purdy felt soreness in his toe following Sunday's loss, and his status for Week 5 on Thursday is up in the air. Purdy missed Weeks 2 and 3 because of a turf toe injury and returned to the lineup Sunday.

news.source: Adam La Rose, Pro Football Rumors (citing Ian Rapoport, NFL Network)
news.words: Purdy has been ruled out for tomorrow's game. He did not miss any time in Sunday's loss; the injured toe was not an issue during the game.

news.source: Ian Rapoport, NFL Network pregame (NBC Sports Bay Area)
news.words: Purdy suffered a setback with the injury, and an MRI revealed an aggravation of the turf toe. "Not major, major, but out tonight -- I'm told he's considered week-to-week. ... He could miss that game as well."

Purdy is considered week to week and has no timetable for his return, Rapoport reported. "He reaggravated it," Shanahan confirmed after Thursday's game. "He's week to week. Don't know how it will heal."

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Ian Rapoport, NFL Network)
news.words: Shanahan confirmed that Purdy is without a timeline for a return after a recent MRI revealed he aggravated the turf toe. The toe has kept him out for the third time in four games.
